name: datamosh-1
_beats: Episode datamosh: 'We break a video file. On purpose.' About one minute, in five parts.
Part 1 (datamosh-1): the finished effect plays, the intro, the promise: no shader, the file is really damaged.
Part 2 (datamosh-2): quick science on why it works, then the transition is removed: from scratch.
Part 3 (datamosh-3): two clips, Transitions, search mosh, drag Datamosh onto the cut; nothing happens yet.
Part 4 (datamosh-4): Properties, Bake Datamosh, the disturbance, and the result plays.
Part 5 (datamosh-5): Data Rate down, rebake, more mess; the sign-off.

scenes.say: [upbeat] Hey, what's up, Dominik Flamer here, and today: we break a video file. [deadpan] On purpose.
[impressed] That's an opera house... [slows down, mysterious] being eaten by a dancer.
[casual] No shader. No glitch plug-in. [deadpan] This file is genuinely damaged.
